title: Table of durable data and backups
goal: One table of who holds durable data and how it is restored
acceptance: Rows for nerv, grover hub, fpvbuddy, hobo server and any other component that stores owner data, each with holder, what is kept, backup schedule, off-host copy and last restore drill (date and link, or "never")
Every cell cites a repository file at a resolved commit or says "unknown"; rows with no drill name the record that plans it (nerv:F-062-T07, a Grover record)
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1.5 h; nine repositories are read for storage only. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
